title: The Final Clue
sections: Maggie的一只凉鞋不见了，Henry排除部分嫌疑人并准备调查。
两位女孩解释了各自在马厩的活动，侦探暂时未找到突破口。
A Dog, a Cat, and a New Trap
Henry看到Little Spot追着猫舔后想到线索，拿走猫玩具准备新的陷阱。

questions.question: What newly disappeared from Maggie's bag?

options.text: A gold watch.
Her detective notebook.
One of her sandals.
Both of her riding gloves.

questions.explanation: Maggie包中两只凉鞋只剩下一只，成为新的失窃线索。

questions.question: Why did Cole believe Zach could not have stolen the sandal?

options.text: He had been in the riding ring when it went missing.
He was on a school trip that day.
He had already left town.
He was helping the police outside the barn.

questions.explanation: 失窃时Zach一直在骑马场，因而可以排除他的嫌疑。

questions.question: What did Eleanor say she did after going into the barn?

options.text: She cleaned Maggie's missing sandal.
She hid inside the tack room.
She repaired the riding ring fence.
She got a tissue and gave Little Spot some water.

questions.explanation: Eleanor解释自己取纸巾后还给又热又渴的Little Spot喂了水。

questions.question: What surprising thing did Little Spot do when he caught the barn cat?

options.text: He carried the cat outside in a basket.
He licked the cat instead of biting her.
He gave the cat a stolen sandal.
He ran away when the cat hissed.

questions.explanation: Little Spot追到猫之后没有咬它，而是不停舔它，让Henry注意到动物的行为。

questions.question: What did Henry take from Maggie's bag to test a new theory?

options.text: A map of the barn.
A blue lollipop.
A cat toy.
A saddle pad.

questions.explanation: Henry决定用Maggie包中的猫玩具设下新的陷阱，验证自己的推断。

title: Who Did It?
sections: A Pirate Clue and Two Possible Places
孩子们发现画着海盗旗的船的线索，猜测宝物在码头或形似海盗船的岩石。
Henry故意分队，和Cole、Maggie私下分析失踪电影票与Roger的嫌疑。
A New Suspicion and a Stranger
三人把怀疑转向Luke与Nathan，却突然遇到从巨石后出现的神秘人物。

questions.question: Whom did Nathan suggest questioning first about the missing tickets?

options.text: The beach lifeguard.
Henry's father.
Roger Redbeard.
The movie theater manager.

questions.explanation: Nathan认为海盗导游Roger Redbeard可能拿了电影票，建议先找他。

questions.question: What was the 'Pirate Ship' on the island?

options.text: A large rock shaped like a ship.
A real boat anchored in the marina.
A newly built museum.
A toy ship on William's desk.

questions.explanation: Luke解释Pirate Ship并不是真船，而是岛北部外形像船的大石头。

questions.question: Why did Henry suggest splitting the treasure-hunt group?

options.text: He was worried that the beach was too crowded.
He wanted to visit the marina alone.
He was trying to avoid the next clue.
He wanted to speak privately with Cole and Maggie about the case.

questions.explanation: Henry承认分组有隐藏目的：让侦探三人单独讨论电影票失踪的谜案。

questions.question: Why did Luke become a possible suspect?

options.text: He had admitted taking all the hats.
He might have been alone with the booty long enough to take the tickets.
He worked for Roger Redbeard.
He refused to watch pirate movies.

questions.explanation: 三人想到Luke曾短暂独自看管宝箱，可能趁Nathan离开时拿走票。

questions.question: What happened as the detectives reached the Pirate Ship rock?

options.text: The missing tickets floated out of the sea.
A real pirate ship arrived at the beach.
A gruff-voiced person stepped out and challenged them.
William's parents canceled the treasure hunt.

questions.explanation: 接近海盗船形巨石时，有人突然从后面出现，用粗声质问他们在做什么。

title: Maggie's Theory
sections: Maggie提出Daisy可能为博取同情故意弄脏自己的衬衫，Henry对此存疑。
Maggie用免费棒棒糖试探Rebecca，得知她因糖尿病不能吃糖。
Henry重新评估蓝色污渍的证据，Cole承认是自己把蓝色棒棒糖放进Daisy口袋。

questions.question: Why did Maggie think Daisy might have ruined her own shirt?

options.text: To avoid spending time at the stable.
To hide a note from her riding teacher.
To gain sympathy and improve her chances of winning a blue ribbon.
To help Rebecca sell lemonade.

questions.explanation: Maggie猜测Daisy故意弄坏衬衫，想博得评委同情并争取蓝色奖带。

questions.question: How did Maggie explain the blue stain on the shirt?

options.text: She thought Daisy might have used a lollipop to stain it.
She believed rain had washed blue paint onto it.
She thought the pony had stepped on it.
She said the judge had spilled blueberry juice.

questions.explanation: Maggie进一步猜测Daisy先用棒棒糖染色，后来又把衬衫扔进水槽。

questions.question: What was Maggie trying to learn by offering Rebecca a free lollipop?

options.text: Whether Rebecca planned to enter the next riding class.
Whether Rebecca had a cat at home.
Whether Rebecca wanted to buy a new shirt.
Whether Rebecca liked blueberry-flavored candy.

questions.explanation: Maggie假装促销，实际上想探听Rebecca是否偏爱蓝莓味棒棒糖。

questions.question: Why did Rebecca refuse both the candy and lemonade?

options.text: She said she was allergic to horses.
She said she had diabetes and could not eat sugar.
She disliked the color of the lemonade stand.
She had already bought too many lollipops.

questions.explanation: Rebecca说明自己有糖尿病，不能摄入糖，因此拒绝甜食和柠檬水。

questions.question: What did Cole finally admit to Henry?

options.text: He had stolen Daisy's shirt from the barn.
He had hidden Rebecca's riding boots.
He had put the blue lollipop in Daisy's shirt pocket.
He had bribed the competition judge.

questions.explanation: Cole最后坦白，是他把蓝色棒棒糖放进Daisy的衬衫口袋；这改变了侦探对污渍证据的判断。

title: Breaking News
sections: A False Alarm at the Tree
侦探赶到所谓突发新闻现场，发现消防员在救被困树上的Tiny和他的猫。
Mrs. Sweet找到了原以为被偷的糖果，侦探们怀疑多条线索只是误会。
A New Problem for the Mayor
游行开始后，侦探花车十分受欢迎，但市长的车突然熄火，谜团重现。

questions.question: What was Jackson's urgent breaking news actually about?

options.text: The detectives' float had caught fire.
The parade had been canceled.
Tiny and his cat had become stuck in a tree.
Someone had stolen the mayor's car.

questions.explanation: 所谓突发新闻其实是Tiny上树救猫后自己也下不来，消防员前来救援。

questions.question: How did Jackson react to the rescue at Tiny's house?

options.text: He wanted to photograph Tiny for a newspaper story.
He tried to stop the firefighters from helping.
He asked the detectives to cancel the parade.
He admitted sabotaging a float.

questions.explanation: Jackson认为这一幕很适合做新闻报道，还想拍摄Tiny的照片。

questions.question: Where did Mrs. Sweet find the candy she thought had been stolen?

options.text: Under her garden shed.
Inside the mayor's float.
In Jackson's camera bag.
In the trunk of her own car.

questions.explanation: Mrs. Sweet承认糖果其实一直放在自己汽车的后备箱，失窃只是误会。

questions.question: Where was the detectives' float positioned when the parade began?

options.text: At the very end of the parade.
Directly behind the mayor's car.
Ahead of all the police cars.
Beside the soccer team's float.

questions.explanation: 游行开始时侦探们的花车就在市长汽车后面。

questions.question: What unexpected event ended the episode?

options.text: The crowd discovered a missing cat.
Mrs. Sweet's candy floated away.
The mayor's car suddenly stopped working.
Henry's bicycle was stolen.

questions.explanation: 结尾市长的车突然熄火，让原本看似结束的破坏谜案出现新的线索。

title: All Tied Up
sections: 警长给生病的Miss Annie送汤，却因胡椒太多让她不停咳嗽，随后准备陪她打牌。
Oswald报告代课的Cleo被套索捆住，Annie担心她没有教授正经课程。
The Sheriff Heads to the Rescue
Roscoe虽然对Cleo搅乱行程很生气，仍离开Annie赶往学校。

questions.question: Why did Sheriff Roscoe bring soup to Miss Annie?

options.text: He wanted to win a cooking contest.
He had been assigned to feed the students.
He had heard she was feeling unwell.
He was delivering lunch to Cleo.

questions.explanation: Roscoe听说Annie身体不舒服，特意带自制汤前来探望。

questions.question: Why did Miss Annie cough after tasting the soup?

options.text: The soup was extremely peppery.
The soup was ice-cold.
There was a fly in the soup.
She accidentally spilled soup on herself.

questions.explanation: 汤放了太多胡椒，Annie喝了一口就咳嗽起来。

questions.question: What activity did Miss Annie suggest they could do together?

options.text: Go horseback riding.
Visit the schoolhouse.
Practice throwing a lasso.
Play a game of cards.

questions.explanation: Annie说自己愿意和Roscoe玩纸牌，两人正准备找一副牌。

questions.question: What problem did Oswald report to the sheriff?

options.text: Miss Annie's favorite horse had escaped.
Deputy Cleo had become tied up with a lasso.
The schoolhouse roof had collapsed.
The students had gone to the railway station.

questions.explanation: Oswald跑来求助，报告代课的Cleo被套索缠住，大家解不开。

questions.question: Why did Miss Annie think letting Cleo teach for a day was a bad idea?

options.text: Cleo had refused to let students go outside.
Cleo could not find the classroom keys.
Cleo had focused on lassoing and deputy stories instead of regular school subjects.
Cleo had canceled the students' lunch break.

questions.explanation: Annie得知Cleo讲套索和副警长故事，而没有正常教授数学、阅读和拼写，感到后悔。
